resources.string: Choose how to get started. Detour assigns Direct, VPN or DPI to each app within one connection.
Bypass throttling without a VPN server. Results depend on your network.
Paste a vless:// key from your VPN provider.
Add your provider’s HTTPS subscription link.
Import a config file or paste an Amnezia key.
Add or import a profile, then select it in the list.
Assign DPI to the apps that need it.
Assign VPN to the apps that need it.
Tap Connect when ready. Android will ask for VPN permission. Detour uses the only VPN slot on your phone.
Some apps already use VPN. Select a VPN profile or change those apps to Direct.
Connected. You are ready to go.
Could not save setup completion. Try again.
Select a profile in the list, then tap Continue.
